verdict.rationale: Digits documents customizable financial statements and reports, plus 'dimensional reporting' on Core and Pro plans, so it offers its own capability in this area. The evidence never says which dimensions exist (class, location, tag) or how reports are filtered and grouped by them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of class/location/tag dimensions, a description of filter and group-by controls in the custom report builder, hands-on or independent corroboration, and availability on lower tiers.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can build custom reports filtered and grouped by class, location, or tag dimensions

citations.quote: Digits Financials generates real-time, customizable financial statements and reports directly from the AGL
Core and Pro plans add custom dashboards and dimensional reporting.
plus dimensional accounting on higher tiers
